name: Subscription and Recurring Bill Audit
format: Spreadsheet for Excel and Google Sheets
subtitle: A tracker for Excel and Google Sheets with a 12-month renewal calendar and a Keep / Cancel / Downgrade column.
meta_description: Track every subscription and recurring bill in one Excel and Google Sheets spreadsheet, with a renewal calendar and decision column. $7, instant download.
card_blurb: Every subscription and recurring bill in one spreadsheet, with a renewal calendar and a decision column.
tagline: List every subscription and recurring bill in one spreadsheet for Excel and Google Sheets.
intro: Enter the name, category, payment method, frequency, amount, next renewal, and notes. Monthly and annual costs are calculated from frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual).
inside: Keep / Cancel / Downgrade column: tallies possible savings. Cancel uses the full annual cost, downgrade uses the difference from a new amount you enter, and keep records zero. These figures record your choices, not a promise of money saved.
12-month renewal calendar: the year is set on Setup (default 2027) and the calendar shows what is due each month.
Dashboard: spend, spend by category with a chart, decision counts, savings found, the top 5 by annual cost, and renewals in the next 30 days.
details: This is a digital download with a fictional sample file, a blank copy, and an instructions PDF. Personal-use terms are included.
You type the numbers. It does not connect to your bank, detect subscriptions, or send reminders. No macros. No physical item is shipped.
